summary: terminal-mascot ships with declared postinstall payload missing and package identity mismatch
details: package.json declares a postinstall hook `node scripts/install-check.cjs` and lists `scripts/` in the `files` array, but no `scripts/` directory is present in the published tarball, so the hook fails with ENOENT on install. The package identity is inconsistent across surfaces: the package name is `terminal-mascot`, the README documents `marked-prettier` ANSI helpers, and the actual shipped code (`index.js`, `kelly.js`) implements Polymarket Kelly-stake math. The `homepage` field points at `https://trabalhos-flax.vercel.app/config/clob-math.json` — a JSON config on an unrelated vercel deployment rather than a project page. The shipped JavaScript performs no network I/O, filesystem access, or process execution, so no installer-side harm is observable from the bytes present in this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
